mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRAVEL_PLACE (PLACE_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, LOCATION, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, MAIN_IMAGE, STATUS, MODIFIED_AT) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{location}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{mainImage}, #{status}, #{modifiedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE TRAVEL_PLACE SET NAME = #{name}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, LOCATION = #{location}, LATITUDE = #{latitude}, LONGITUDE = #{longitude}, MAIN_IMAGE = #{mainImage}, STATUS = #{status}, MODIFIED_AT = #{modifiedAt} WHERE PLACE_ID = #{placeId}
